note: Pack v5 (0.2.8) — all 19 workflows LIVE, all text in English. 0.2.8 additions: Evening Brightness (time 18:00 -> direct set_brightness 25), Music Volume Guard (app_group_used 'Music' -> direct set_volume 25; never fires until a 'Music' group exists), Notification Watcher sample (notification_posted, OFF by default). Intruder Alert now also captures a front-camera photo (threshold in Settings, default 2).

message.text: Good morning, Boss! My Care is with you again today — together we will take care of your studies, your rest and your phone's health. Have a great day!
message.title: Welcome Boss! 👋

message.text: Opening and closing apps again and again — not sure what to do? Let's do something good:
message.title: Feeling bored, Boss?

message.text: You have been using your phone continuously for {minutes} minutes. Give your eyes a 2-minute break — studying also works better with a fresh mind.
message.title: Take a little rest, Boss

message.text: You have been using {app} for {minutes} minutes. You are studying... no... then you will fail! If this is not study, please take a small break.
message.title: A small suggestion, Boss

message.text: Good morning! Let's start today's study. Set one small target and keep the phone aside — My Care will keep watch.
message.title: Time to study, Boss 📚

message.text: It is time to sleep. If you want an alarm, tap 'Open Clock' — your Clock app will open, and you can set the alarm for your time there.
message.title: Shall we set an alarm, Boss? ⏰

message.text: {hisaab}
message.title: Today's Account 📊

message.text: It's been a while — have a glass of water. Staying hydrated between study sessions keeps your focus strong.
message.title: Drink some water, Boss 💧

message.text: Battery has reached {percent}%, please unplug the charger. An alarm-style reminder will also arrive in 1 minute.
message.title: ⚠️ Phone Fully Charged!

message.text: Only {percent}% battery is left. Please plug in the charger — the phone should not switch off in the middle of study.
message.title: Battery is low, Boss 🔋

message.text: What should be done with this screenshot, Boss?
message.title: Screenshot taken

message.text: Choose the auto-delete time. Note: Android may sometimes ask for a system confirmation before deleting — that notification will arrive.
message.title: When should I delete it?

message.text: {name} has been added to your phone. Start a chat on WhatsApp?
message.title: New contact saved 👤

message.text: Which group should the new app go into? Tap the notification and choose a group in the popup.
message.title: New app installed 📲

message.text: {app}'s cache has reached {cache}, Boss. Open App Info and tap 'Clear cache' — the phone will stay light.
message.title: Cache has grown big 🧹

message.text: Boss, is someone trying to open your phone? The wrong password was entered repeatedly. If it wasn't you, keep the phone with you. My Care also tries to capture a photo of the person — see System → Running Services → View captures.
message.title: Intruder Alert! 🚨

message.text: {app} has not been opened for more than 30 days, Boss (there are {count} such apps in total). If you don't need it, uninstall it and free up space.
message.title: Cleaning up old apps 🗑️

message.text: It's 6 PM, Boss — screen brightness has been set to 25% automatically, so your eyes stay comfortable for the evening.
message.title: Evening brightness 🌆

message.text: A Music app just opened, Boss — media volume has been set to 25% automatically to keep your ears safe. Note: this works only if a group named 'Music' exists (Home tab) with your music apps in it.
message.title: Volume set for your ears 🎧

message.text: This is a SAMPLE workflow, Boss: it fires on ANY app's notification ({app}: {text}). Edit it from the Workflows tab — or make your own with the AI tab, e.g. only WhatsApp, or only messages containing a word like OTP.
message.title: Notification from {app}
